subject: Web Development
title: ES6: JavaScript's Rebirth
description: Learn ES6: JavaScript's Rebirth in one minute.

hook.text: For ten years the language barely changed. Then ES6 landed in 2015 and changed everything.

buildup.text: Arrow functions, classes, template literals, and destructuring made JavaScript feel modern.

discovery.text: Let and const replaced var, fixing the confusing scoping rules that haunted developers.

twist.text: Browsers didn't support ES6 yet. Developers had to 'transpile' new code into old syntax.

climax.text: ES6 was so well-received that annual updates became the norm — ES7, ES8, and beyond.

punchline.text: Ten years of silence ended with a revolution.
